title: 第1章 刻纹师与血纹战士第2章 鬼影匪团
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
漆黑的云像压在地面上让人喘不上气，暴风雪越来越猛烈。
除了耳边呼呼的风声，几乎听不见任何别的声音。
一行人沿着蜿蜒的山路缓慢前行，带头的光头汉子巴安单手拄着杖，另一只手按着头顶的羊毛帽子，眯着眼抬头看了看漆黑的夜空，颠了颠肩上捕捉的三角羊，重重的吸了口凉气，两米长的三角羊在他肩上显得格外娇小。
不过多久，十几所建在半山腰的小村落便出现在几人眼前。
众人快步进入中间最大的一所屋内，都松了口气，屋内炙热的火炉让几人不禁起一阵鸡皮疙瘩。
“天冷的鼻子都冻掉咯！”
巴安搓搓手脱下兽皮大衣，摘掉头顶的帽子，扫了扫油光铮亮的光头，几大步靠近火炉后盘腿坐下，取下火炉上温着的牛角壶，朝嘴里灌了几大口酒。
“呼……这鬼天气，没完没了，啥时候是个头！”
说罢随即看了看四周，焦急问道“哎，戈子，那边现在到底什么情况？”
只见身旁同样皱着眉头烤火的年轻男子面貌俊美，皮肤白皙，一头长发被白色发带束在脑后，人在火光前被映射的宛如油画一般，一幅书生模样背后背着的一柄巨斧却显得格格不入。
戈子看看巴安，摇了摇头叹声道:“连师说，阿乌可能是不行了，她的精神力和生命气息正在逐渐散去，族里的产婆正在找法子接生那娃。”
巴安听后皱眉，随即站起来，双手握实贴在眉心，真诚的低声道:“圣塔山神保佑，那娃强壮得很，强壮得很……”
不久后，一名老妇人进了木屋看了看屋内的几位战士，神色莫名得道
“娃儿没事，不过……奇怪得很。”
周围的几人对视一眼，快步出了木屋，跟着老妇人走去。
阿皓睁开乌黑透亮的眼睛，看了看周围身穿各色兽皮，脸上涂着各种怪异涂鸦的陌生人。
“这孩子怎么不哭？”
“打了吗？”
“打了，就是没声，但是连师看了说没事。”
屋内几人好奇的看着这个满头黑发只有小臂大小婴儿，同样婴儿也好奇的打量着这几个打扮奇异的大汉，和他们身上隐隐泛着青光的纹身。

此时里屋一名披着黑色蟒纹衣袍的古稀老者走了过来，灰白的头发整齐的贴在两鬓上方，脸上布满了沧桑的皱纹，深邃的眼眸泛着悠悠蓝光，却显得深不可测，嘴角慈祥的笑意令人倍感亲切。
众人见到老者，都微微躬身“连师！”
连师扫了一下他们，点点头，神色悲伤道“阿乌没有扛过去，回到圣塔山神怀抱了。”
巴安戈子几人闻言，不由一怔，纷纷悲痛不已，在这个时代，类似他们这种部落中这种事比比皆是，但还是忍不住的祈祷，这些都是他们的家人，互相扶持的最亲密的伙伴。
连师抱起刚刚落生的婴儿，打量着这个东张西望无处不好奇的小家伙，此时经过一晚狂风的肆虐，天边终于露出一丝阳光，柔柔的照在老人沧桑切慈祥的脸上。
微笑道“皓，以后你叫皓！”
在祝福部落迎来了一位新成员的同时，又为已经永远离开他们的阿乌献上祈福。
七年后
浓密的山林中，几个二十岁左右的青年身穿兽皮，手中拿着沉重的阔斧。
带头的两名壮汉正警惕着周围。
在几人身后不远处，有着数十人组成的狩猎小队，地上十几只形状各异的野兽尸体彰显着这支狩猎队不俗的实力。
“阿皓，塔子哥他们一定可以的对嘛？”
狩猎队中十岁的邬童问道。
content_en:
Dark clouds pressed down on the ground, making people breathless, and the blizzard became more and more fierce.
Apart from the whistling of the wind in my ears, there was almost no other sound.
The group of people walked slowly along the winding mountain road. The leader, the bald man Baan, held a stick with one hand and held the woolen hat on his head with the other hand. He squinted and looked up at the dark night sky. He bumped the three-cornered sheep caught on his shoulders and took a deep breath. The two-meter-long three-cornered sheep looked particularly petite on his shoulders.
Not long after, a dozen small villages built halfway up the mountain appeared in front of a few people.
Everyone quickly entered the largest room in the middle and breathed a sigh of relief. The hot stove in the room made several people feel goosebumps.
“It’s so cold that my nose will freeze off!”
Baan rubbed his hands and took off his animal fur coat, took off the hat on his head, swept his shiny bald head, took a few steps closer to the stove and sat down cross-legged, took off the horn pot that was warm on the stove, and poured a few swigs of wine into his mouth.
"Huh...this damn weather will never end, when will it end!"
After saying that, he looked around and asked anxiously, "Hey, Gezi, what's going on over there now?"
I saw the young man next to me who was also frowning and warming up to the fire. He had a handsome face, fair skin, and long hair tied back by a white hairband. The person was reflected in front of the fire like an oil painting, but the giant ax carried on his back seemed out of place for the scholar.
Gezi looked at Baan, shook his head and sighed: "Master Lian said that Awu may not be able to survive. Her mental power and life breath are gradually dissipating. The midwife in the clan is looking for a way to deliver the baby."
Ba'an frowned after hearing this, then stood up, put his hands firmly between his eyebrows, and whispered sincerely: "Blessed by the God of the Holy Tower Mountain, that baby is very strong, very strong..."
Not long after, an old woman entered the wooden house and looked at the few soldiers in the house with an inexplicable look on her face.
"Baby is fine, but...it's very strange."
Several people around looked at each other, quickly left the cabin, and followed the old woman.
Ah Hao opened his dark and translucent eyes and looked around at the strangers wearing various animal skins and with all kinds of weird graffiti on their faces.
"Why doesn't this child cry?"
"Did you hit him?"
"It was beaten, but there was no sound, but the company commander looked at it and said it was fine."
Several people in the room looked curiously at the baby with black hair and the size of his forearm. The baby also looked curiously at these tall men dressed in strange clothes and the tattoos on their bodies that were faintly glowing with green light.
At this time, an old man wearing a black python-patterned robe came over from the back room. His gray hair was neatly stuck to his temples, his face was covered with wrinkles, and his deep eyes were glowing with blue light, but they seemed unfathomable. The kind smile on the corner of his mouth made people feel friendly.
When everyone saw the old man, they bowed slightly and said, "Lian Shi!"
The company commander glanced at them, nodded, and said sadly, "Awu didn't carry it, and returned to the embrace of the Holy Tower Mountain God."
When the Baangezi heard this, they couldn't help but be startled and grieved. In this era, such things are common in tribes like theirs, but they still couldn't help but pray. These are their families and the closest partners who support each other.
The company commander picked up the newly born baby and looked at the little guy who was looking around curiously. At this time, after a night of raging wind, a ray of sunshine finally appeared in the sky, shining softly on the old man's kind face.
He smiled and said, "Hao, from now on you will be called Hao!"
While blessing the tribe for welcoming a new member, they also pray for Awu who has left them forever.
seven years later
In the dense mountain forest, several young men in their twenties were wearing animal skins and holding heavy broadaxes in their hands.
The two strong men in the lead were watching the surroundings.
Not far behind a few people, there is a hunting team composed of dozens of people. More than a dozen beast corpses of different shapes on the ground highlight the hunting team.The team’s strength is impressive.
"Ah Hao, Brother Ta Zi and the others can definitely do it, right?"
asked Wu Tong, a ten-year-old member of the hunting team.
